newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Montoro sees 96 GDP at "nearly" 2.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Montoro sees 96 GDP at "nearly" 2.3 pct.

text.p: Spanish Economy Secretary Cristobal Montoro on Wednesday qualified the government's economic forecast for the year, saying the economy would grow "nearly" 2.3 percent in 1996.

"Domestic demand is proving to be the real motor of economic recovery. (Its) good performance will bring us nearly 2.3-percent growth this year and will allow the pace to speed up next year," Montoro told a congressional committee.
The government had forecast growth in 1996 of 2.3 percent last spring.
